verdict.rationale: Brevo documents event-triggered automation: unlimited multi-step workflows, follow-up emails triggered automatically on form sign-up, and contact scores that trigger automations. The evidence is marketing-level only and does not show the rule-definition model or a way to define rules programmatically or through AI, so story coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: documentation of rule/condition configuration (triggers, branching, event types), programmatic or AI-driven definition of automation rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Create an unlimited number of automated, multi-step workflows to engage users at key moments along their journey.
Automatically trigger follow-up emails as soon as someone signs up.
Get contact scores based on engagement, purchases, and behaviors to trigger automations or create targeted segments.
Track custom user events and behaviors.
